description: Info-trafic en cours des transports en commun Naolib de Nantes Métropole is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Semitan. Trafic en temps réel des trams, bus et navibus Naolib. Les travaux et déviations sont indiqués; ils sont accompagnés des dates et heures de début et fin de perturbation. Ces données sont produites et mises à jour par la Semitan. Coverage: Semitan. The publisher named on the listing is Semitan. Its keywords include naolib, mobilite, transport-en-commun, temps-reel, deplacement. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, CSV. The listing shows 2026-06-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
